name: @missing-elements/h5p-mcp
description: H5P Author MCP by Missing Elements: a local MCP server that builds playable H5P packages of any content type from a short source, checks them in a real player and opens them in the person's browser. No H5P server needed.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @missing-elements/h5p-offline-player build && pnpm --filter @missing-elements/h5p-author exec node scripts/copy-skill.mjs && vitest run
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Publish with pnpm publish: npm would ship the workspace:^ dependency ranges as they are, and the package would not install.'); process.exit(1) }" && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
